intro.narration: [excited] What's ninety-five times ninety-five? [pause] Do it in your head.

steps.narration: [curious] Any number ending in five is fast to square. [pause] Take ninety-five.
[confident] Multiply the tens digit, nine, by the next number, ten. [pause] That's ninety.
[excited] Then stick twenty-five on the end. [pause] Ninety-five squared is nine-thousand twenty-five. [warm] Try it on your own number.
